name: David Smith
scenario: Runs the whole domain. Sets up group policies, automation and workflows, and hands routine tasks to the helpdesk.
bio: I manage the whole domain and make technical propositions to my managers.
I am qualified and have several years of experience. There is a good chance I started on a helpdesk and understand call centres and tech support structures.
needsAndExpectations: Our environments are mostly hybrid environment, in large companies. Transitioning from On Prem.
Able to administer group policies, automation tasks, and workflows,
motivations: Object management and automation of tasks that can be delegated whilst I setup more complex policies and workflows
Easier ways to automate hybrid environment tasks, and provision helpdesk users with ARS.
Better ways to delegate permissions with active roles.
painPoints: I don’t have time for WebUI to load, or process actions that take seconds in MMC.
Does not want SaaS to manage B2B B2C.
